summary: Firefox’s media and audio plumbing now handles track resets, seeks, live-stream durations, and Opus decoder settings more reliably, while keeping audio-related promises on the correct graph thread. Image and video conversion work improves I420 and NV12 output, RGB-to-YUV color selection, and rotation handling. The area also updates web-platform policy terminology from Feature Policy to Permissions Policy and modernizes some diagnostics and performance markers.
